note: CORRECTION: early single-shot profiles read 248us and attributed 64% to SFPU sigmoid. Re-measurement showed 248us was a transient environmental effect (same config reproducibly 102us later), AND the per-phase zone wraps each helper INCLUDING its cb_wait_front, so a starved phase reads as a slow phase. True profile: no phase dominates (p2 21%, p4 17%, p7b 16%, p7c 14%, p1 12%); op is near DRAM roofline.

text: Route 1 (preserve fp32 sum-of-squares off DEST) requires an fp32 accumulator that bypasses DEST. Confirmed fp32-DEST-only in 3 places in examples/row_reduce_accumulate (README method table, program descriptor comment: a bf16 DEST corrupts the accumulate, accuracy row). Float32 cb_sumsq buys nothing under a narrower DEST. dest_accum_pairs is bf16-error reduction not fp32. Chain L1Accumulation is one-accumulator-per-chain vs P1 needing one per token. Route 1 closed.
